title: Creator Premium Content Safety Policy Candidate v1

authority.approval_note: This file is a review candidate only. It is not an approved Nelyon community standard or terms-of-service amendment.

decision_model.allowed: No active signal and every required modality completed against current evidence; publication still depends on canonical account, media, and commercial checks.
decision_model.suspicious_signal: A deterministic text phrase or model output is triage evidence only and routes the exact content to bounded human review.
decision_model.confirmed_violation: A separately authorized human safety decision may quarantine or remove the exact content and evidence; a model output alone is not legal proof.
decision_model.restricted: The content remains private and no new private-media grants may be issued while a blocking signal or restriction is active.
decision_model.false_positive: A no_violation resolution is bound to the exact content, owner, asset, fingerprint, analysis, model, prompt, policy, finding, actor, reason, and timestamp.
decision_model.appeal_or_review: Restoration never publishes directly; it returns the content to canonical automated verification and preserves the audit trail.
decision_model.technical_error: Missing policy, provider error, invalid output, timeout, missing modality, stale fingerprint, or inaccessible private media fails closed and is never converted into PASS.

rules.name: Explicit CSAM reference — English
rules.rationale: Route an explicit English reference to child sexual abuse material for urgent human safety review; do not treat the phrase itself as proof.
benign_examples: A documentary caption condemning child sexual abuse material.
rules.false_positive_risk: High in journalism, education, victim-support, and policy discussion because the phrase can describe prevention rather than prohibited media.

rules.name: Referencia explícita a MASI — Español
rules.rationale: Enviar una referencia explícita en español a material de abuso sexual infantil a revisión humana urgente sin convertir la frase en prueba.
benign_examples: Un documental que condena el material de abuso sexual infantil.
rules.false_positive_risk: Alto en periodismo, educación, apoyo a víctimas y políticas públicas porque la frase puede describir prevención o denuncia.

rules.name: Sexual exploitation reference — English
rules.rationale: Route an explicit sexual-exploitation reference to human safety review while preserving the distinction between a signal and a confirmed violation.
benign_examples: An educational interview about preventing sexual exploitation.
rules.false_positive_risk: High for prevention, reporting, survivor advocacy, news, and educational material that names the prohibited conduct.

rules.name: Referencia a explotación sexual — Español
rules.rationale: Enviar una referencia explícita a explotación sexual a revisión humana de seguridad y conservar la diferencia entre señal e infracción confirmada.
benign_examples: Una entrevista educativa sobre cómo prevenir la explotación sexual.
rules.false_positive_risk: Alto para prevención, denuncias, apoyo a sobrevivientes, noticias y educación que nombran la conducta prohibida.

rules.name: Non-consensual intimate imagery reference — English
rules.rationale: Route an explicit non-consensual-intimate-imagery reference to specialized human review; the detector cannot establish consent by itself.
benign_examples: A victim-support resource explaining non-consensual intimate imagery.
rules.false_positive_risk: High for legal assistance, victim support, journalism, and educational discussion that explicitly names the category.

rules.name: Referencia a imágenes íntimas sin consentimiento — Español
rules.rationale: Enviar una referencia explícita a imágenes íntimas sin consentimiento a revisión especializada; el detector no puede establecer consentimiento.
benign_examples: Un recurso de apoyo explica las imágenes íntimas sin consentimiento.
rules.false_positive_risk: Alto para asistencia legal, apoyo a víctimas, periodismo y educación que mencionan expresamente la categoría.

rules.name: Credible threat reference — English
rules.rationale: Route an explicit credible-threat reference for contextual human review; text matching alone cannot establish intent, target, imminence, or credibility.
benign_examples: A news analysis discusses whether authorities found a credible threat.
rules.false_positive_risk: High for news, fiction, legal analysis, safety training, and quotations because context determines whether a threat is real.

rules.name: Referencia a amenaza creíble — Español
rules.rationale: Enviar una referencia a amenaza creíble a revisión humana contextual; una frase no determina intención, objetivo, inminencia ni credibilidad.
benign_examples: Un análisis periodístico pregunta si las autoridades encontraron una amenaza creíble.
rules.false_positive_risk: Alto para noticias, ficción, análisis legal, capacitación de seguridad y citas donde el contexto define la amenaza.

rules.name: Illegal violent attack reference — English
rules.rationale: Route a direct reference to an illegal violent attack for contextual review without treating descriptive or documentary speech as a confirmed violation.
benign_examples: A documentary condemns an illegal violent attack.
rules.false_positive_risk: High for documentaries, news, historical discussion, fictional narratives, and victim testimony that describe violent events.

rules.name: Referencia a ataque violento ilegal — Español
rules.rationale: Enviar una referencia directa a un ataque violento ilegal a revisión contextual sin tratar lenguaje descriptivo como infracción confirmada.
benign_examples: Un documental condena un ataque violento ilegal.
rules.false_positive_risk: Alto para documentales, noticias, historia, ficción y testimonios de víctimas que describen hechos violentos.

rules.name: Fraudulent payment instructions reference — English
rules.rationale: Route an explicit reference to fraudulent payment instructions for contextual review; the phrase does not prove that fraud is being performed.
benign_examples: A security lesson explains how to recognize fraudulent payment instructions.
rules.false_positive_risk: High for security education, fraud prevention, support, news, and incident response that name the tactic directly.

rules.name: Referencia a instrucciones de pago fraudulentas — Español
rules.rationale: Enviar una referencia explícita a instrucciones de pago fraudulentas a revisión contextual; la frase no prueba que se esté cometiendo fraude.
benign_examples: Una capacitación explica cómo reconocer instrucciones de pago fraudulentas.
rules.false_positive_risk: Alto para educación de seguridad, prevención, soporte, noticias y respuesta a incidentes que nombran la táctica.

activation_prerequisites: Owner approves the normative policy text and exact categories.
Legal, privacy, youth-safety, App Store, Google Play, and payment-provider reviews are complete.
Every draft rule is previewed against bounded real-world samples and benign counterexamples.
A separately authorized admin approves and enables each exact fingerprint through canonical governance RPCs.
Provider component validation and full private-media E2E are completed in a non-production environment.
Operational quotas, budget, incident response, appeals, and rollback owners are approved.
